items.name: AP Biology Complete Mastery
items.description: Complete AP Biology study vault covering Cell Energetics, Genetics, Molecular Biology, Evolution, and Ecology with structured review prompts.
items.author: Dr. Marcus Vance

sampleCards.front: What is the primary function of ATP Synthase in the inner mitochondrial membrane?
sampleCards.back: ATP Synthase utilizes the proton electrochemical gradient (chemiosmosis) across the inner membrane to phosphorylate ADP into ATP during oxidative phosphorylation.

sampleCards.front: State the Central Dogma of Molecular Biology.
sampleCards.back: Genetic information flows from DNA to RNA (transcription) and from RNA to Protein (translation).

sampleCards.front: What defines an allosteric enzyme inhibitor?
sampleCards.back: An allosteric inhibitor binds to a regulatory site away from the active site, inducing a conformational shift that reduces substrate affinity.

sampleCards.front: Differentiate between Bottleneck Effect and Founder Effect in genetic drift.
sampleCards.back: Bottleneck: Sudden population size reduction from environmental catastrophe. Founder: Small group colonizes new habitat, isolating a non-representative gene pool.

items.name: JavaScript & TypeScript Full Mastery
items.description: Comprehensive modern JavaScript (ES6-ESNext) and TypeScript deep dive: event loop, async/await, closures, utility types, and AST transformations.
items.author: Alex Chen

sampleCards.front: Explain the JavaScript Microtask vs Macrotask event loop execution order.
sampleCards.back: After each macrotask (setTimeout, I/O, UI render) completes, the engine drains the ENTIRE microtask queue (Promises, queueMicrotask, MutationObserver) before executing the next macrotask.

sampleCards.front: What is the difference between `unknown` and `any` in TypeScript?
sampleCards.back: `any` turns off type-checking completely. `unknown` is a type-safe counterpart that requires explicit type narrowing or assertions before invoking methods on it.

sampleCards.front: How does JavaScript Prototypal Inheritance resolve properties?
sampleCards.back: When accessing `obj.prop`, JS looks on `obj`. If absent, it inspects `Object.getPrototypeOf(obj)` (`__proto__`) recursively up to `Object.prototype`, ending at `null`.

sampleCards.front: What is the utility of TypeScript's `ReturnType<T>`?
sampleCards.back: `ReturnType<T>` extracts the return type of a function type `T` using the `infer` keyword in a conditional type: `T extends (...args: any[]) => infer R ? R : any`.

items.name: MCAT High-Yield Behavioral Sciences
items.description: Complete Psychology and Sociology roadmap aligned with AAMC MCAT foundational concepts: cognitive bias, social structures, conditioning, and perception.
items.author: Dr. Sarah Lin

sampleCards.front: What is the Fundamental Attribution Error?
sampleCards.back: The tendency for observers to underestimate situational factors and overestimate dispositional/personality factors when explaining others' negative behaviors.

sampleCards.front: Compare classical conditioning with operant conditioning.
sampleCards.back: Classical: Pairs an involuntary stimulus-response reflex (Pavlovian). Operant: Pairs voluntary behavior with rewards or punishments to alter reinforcement frequency (Skinner).

sampleCards.front: What does the Yerkes-Dodson Law state about arousal and performance?
sampleCards.back: Performance peaks at an optimal level of intermediate physiological or mental arousal, deteriorating when arousal is too low or excessively high.

items.name: Modern World History: The Cold War Era
items.description: High-yield review topic detailing geopolitical blocs, proxy conflicts, nuclear deterrence doctrines, and the dissolution of the USSR.
items.author: Prof. Arthur Pendelton

sampleCards.front: What was the primary doctrine of the Truman Doctrine (1947)?
sampleCards.back: An American foreign policy pledge to provide political, military, and economic assistance to democratic nations resisting authoritarian or communist subjugation.

sampleCards.front: Define Mutually Assured Destruction (MAD).
sampleCards.back: A military strategy and national security doctrine where full-scale deployment of nuclear weapons by opposing sides causes the complete annihilation of both attacker and defender.

items.name: Linear Algebra for Machine Learning
items.description: Vectors, matrices, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, SVD, PCA decomposition, and gradient descent geometry explained intuitively for AI practitioners.
items.author: Kaelen Mercer

sampleCards.front: Geometrically, what does an Eigenvector represent during a matrix transformation?
sampleCards.back: An eigenvector is a non-zero vector whose direction remains unchanged when a linear transformation is applied; it is only scaled by its corresponding eigenvalue factor λ (Av = λv).

sampleCards.front: Why is Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) useful in Principal Component Analysis (PCA)?
sampleCards.back: SVD factors any m×n matrix X into U Σ V^T, finding orthogonal axes of maximum variance to compress high-dimensional feature spaces without losing critical variance.
